layouts.name: New York Safety Track
layouts.description: The full paved circuit follows the main straight, northern hairpin, upper switchback and southern wooded technical section visible in the independent 2019 aerial image. Pit-entry and paddock driveways are excluded. The operator identifies one full circuit with 18 turns; its advertised 2.2-mile length is approximate and is not used to scale the geometry. Independently digitized aerial centerline: 3141.9 m. Direction, historical configuration and fine corner alignment remain draft; no course coordinates come from the comparison catalogue.
